method.source: Authenticated new paired diagnostic exports; verified original SHA-256; exact build; deduplicated by run/sequence/code.
method.period: Only events after each side logged the latest common CONNECTED event. Installation-time reconnect attempts and historical lastFailure are excluded from recurrence.
method.latency: Local software elapsed durations only; no cross-machine timestamp subtraction and no physical mouse-to-screen claim.
method.comparison: The g514 and g515 physical trials are uncontrolled and differ in duration/sample count; do not attribute changes in maxima to the instrumentation.

detailedTiming.caveat: First/worst may refer to the same command. Detail presence demonstrates retention in these profiles, not independent command count or guaranteed coverage beyond time/count caps.

actualMaximum.interpretation: The 125.365ms tail is in an incomplete diagnostic profile and must not be hidden by the 20.174ms complete-pair maximum. Its worker apply is 119.815ms, while native submission is 6.243ms and the inner IPC vector totals 15.249ms. These are distinct containing/overlapping measurements, not additive components or a proven scheduler residual.

detailedTiming.nextBoundary: Source inspection places the native IPC start after portable Client.mu acquisition and request preparation. Containing apply also spans work after matched IPC completion. Measure pre-IPC lock/preparation and post-IPC completion separately before attributing this tail to transport, native submission or scheduler delay.

interpretation: A retains a nonfatal 1563.890ms sample interval with 1464.373ms timer lateness and >1s aggregate GC-total, GC-stopping and runnable observations. The GC-stopping delay remains present while the connection stays healthy.
A also retains 577.471ms timer lateness with coarse GC-total/stopping observations. Bucket rounding does not prove an exact 577ms GC pause.
A metrics sampling envelope spans 176.546ms without new GC total/stopping observations. This is not proof that metrics.Read itself blocked or caused a global process stall.
GC CPU values are runtime accounting across processors, not observed OS CPU use. Independent histogram durations must not be added or subtracted.
A sampled heap was approximately 1.9MB in these windows. The evidence does not establish a large-heap scan, a memory leak, or the exact Windows thread/runtime mechanism.
The 1.46s timer lateness is not a measured 1.46s screen crossing. Complete-pair capture activation is 12.577ms median and 24.376ms maximum.

preparation.interpretation: The slow complete entry claimed a freshly prepared candidate while native loading/readiness was still in progress. These startup spans overlap; do not sum them or label the source grant wait as pure network RTT.

conclusion: No post-connect reconnect/recovery fault in the approximately seven-minute retained g515 window. Both services/input READY. A runtime stopping and B preparation/apply tails remain; evidence capture is verified, root-cause resolution is not.
validation: Raw export hashes, exact-build filtering, shared connection, 14 matched/13 complete pairs, all 28 first/worst native-IPC and ACK-read profiles, JSON and git diff checked. No executable change; code tests, rebuild, reinstall and remote CI skipped. No push.
